neutral.$description: The neutral ramp of shadcn/ui's stock `neutral` theme (D-43): OKLCH, chroma 0. Step names follow Tailwind's neutral scale; 0 is white.

white-alpha.$description: White at an opacity: the stock dark theme draws its borders this way. The step is the opacity in percent.

70.$description: White at 70%: the frosted surface in light mode (D-47).

neutral-900-alpha.$description: Neutral 900 at an opacity: the frosted surface in dark mode (D-47) — the stock dark raised surface (card, popover), let through. The step is the opacity in percent.

black-alpha.$description: Black at an opacity: the small shadow of a frosted surface (D-47), light (10) and dark (40). The step is the opacity in percent.

red.$description: The two reds of the stock theme's destructive role. Step names follow Tailwind's red scale.

blue.$description: The blue of the stock dark theme's sidebar-primary role. Step name follows Tailwind's blue scale.

system.$description: CSS system colours, stored as keywords (string tokens — TOKENS.md § One source). They have no mode: the user agent resolves them.

highlight.$description: The system colour for selected and focused items; the only colour that survives forced-colors.
